Tuple CLI for managing contacts, calls, and application state.

Usage:
  tuple [command]

Available Commands:
  agent         Agent operating guidance and communication
  auth          Finish the login process
  call          Call lifecycle
  capture       Capture and inspect call history
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  connect       Connect an AI agent to Tuple
  contacts      People and availability
  help          Help about any command
  login         Start the login process
  logout        Log out
  machines      List your other connected machines
  mcp           Start MCP server over stdin/stdout
  notifications External call notifications
  rooms         Rooms and persistent spaces
  screen        Capture the shared screen
  start         Ensure the daemon is started
  state         Show current application state
  stop          Stop the daemon
  version       Print the app version
  whoami        Print the authenticated user's identity

Deprecated Commands:
  new           Start and join a new call with your personal URL
  set           Update a setting with the given value
  settings      List all settings and their values
  share         Share your screen
  ui            Show experimental debugging UI
  unshare       Unshare your screen

Flags:
      --format format   output format: "text" or "json" (default text)
  -h, --help            help for tuple

Use "tuple [command] --help" for more information about a command.
